Complete [[Abaddon's Mouth]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Open the [[Door of Komalie]] on the [[Ring of Fire Island Chain|Ring of Fire Islands]].
* *BONUS* Guide the spirit of [[Leah Stone]] to her rest.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[Abaddon's Mouth#walkthrough|Abaddon's Mouth]].

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Mission]]
:''"Are you the one in the prophecy? [[Vizier Khilbron]] anxiously awaits one who will fulfill the prophecies and open the Door of Komalie on the Ring of Fire Islands."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*This [[quest]] was offered for the first time on July 22, 2009.
